A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

A little more
clarity.

Product information, delivery, and the details behind The Lab.

Talk to the BKG team ↗
What is The Lab?

The Lab is BKG’s private research community, bringing together educational materials, trusted resources, and a carefully curated selection of research products.

Who are these products for?

BKG materials are intended for laboratory research purposes only, not for human or animal use. BKG’s store is restricted to adults 21 and older.

Where can I find product information?

Explore the collection and open a material to visit its current BKG product page. For supporting documentation or other questions, contact the BKG team.

How does shipping work?

Orders over $200 qualify for free shipping. The published shipping policy lists typical processing of 1–3 business days, followed by estimated delivery of 2–7 business days. Timing is not guaranteed. Read the full shipping policy ↗

How can I become an affiliate?

Apply with information about your audience and how you would introduce BKG. Approved affiliates can earn 15% on eligible product sales through an assigned referral link or code. Explore the affiliate program →
